user.title: NPR Parkeren
user.description: One entry per Dutch municipality. The area manager is looked up from RDW open data.

data_description.municipality: Name of the municipality, for example Kerkrade. The area manager id is resolved during setup.
data_description.latitude: Latitude used for 'regulated here' and the search centre.
data_description.longitude: Longitude used for 'regulated here' and the search centre.
data_description.radius_km: Zones whose centroid is within this radius, or that contain the point, are shown.

select_manager.title: Choose area manager
select_manager.description: More than one area manager matched. Choose the municipality to add.

error.cannot_connect: The RDW open data portal could not be reached.
error.municipality_not_found: No area manager was found for that name.

abort.municipality_not_found: No area manager was found for that name.

init.title: NPR Parkeren options
init.description: Polling, radius, map markers, and the gazette keyword.

data_description.scan_interval: Minimum 300 seconds. NPR tables themselves refresh every 12 hours.
data_description.radius_km: Search radius around the configured coordinates.
data_description.max_map_markers: Cap on zone markers. Markers outside the cap are removed immediately.
data_description.keyword: Second search term for the official gazette. Default is verkeersbesluit.
data_description.enable_markers: Create device tracker pins for zones inside the radius.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Force a refresh of NPR parking data for every configured municipality.
